about_the_game:
🎭 Immersive Atmosphere

Experience a deep horror journey with realistic graphics, mist and steam effects, echoing sound design, and a minimal interface.

🧩 Unique Levels

The game will expand with regular updates, adding new rooms and chapters.
Each level is filled with different puzzles, escape routes, and surprises to keep you on edge.

👹 Dangerous Entities

Escape from the entities lurking in the dark corners of the bathhouse.
They see you as a reflection of their own lost soul… and they will never let you go.

🔄 Constant Updates

Throughout development, new chapters, environments, and horror elements will be added.
With every update, players will step into a new nightmare. Be ready to be surprised in every chapter!

🎧 Echoing Sounds

Every step you take echoes, every breath you make bounces back from the walls.
Use your voice carefully, because you might not be the only one who hears it.

⭐ Hamam is an indie project that will continue to grow with regular updates during Early Access. By adding it to your wishlist, you won’t miss the release date and you’ll also contribute to the development process.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent scenes of violence, blood, and disturbing imagery. 
It includes dark and oppressive environments, supernatural horror elements, 
and terrifying situations that may not be suitable for all players. 
There is no sexual content, but the atmosphere can be very intense and frightening.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 veya AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti veya AMD R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 veya AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Step into Hamam — a haunting twist on the Backrooms formula. Tired of the endless yellow walls? Here, every corner is shrouded in steam, echoes, and terror. But beware: this is only the beginning... More chapters, chilling environments, and terrifying updates await with every release.
